name: Blender / KhronosGroup glTF-Blender-IO
zh: 魔方空间的住宅、公司、海岛和上海静态场景使用 Blender 5.2.1 编辑，以内置 glTF 插件导入、导出 GLB。首次迁移使用 Three.js GLTFExporter；本站维护场景属性、纹理去重和网页加载脚本，未复制 Blender 插件源码。魔方、天气、水面和交通仍由 Three.js 实时运行。查阅于 2026-09-08
en: Homes, office, island and Shanghai static scenes are edited in Blender 5.2.1 and imported/exported as GLB through its bundled glTF add-on. The initial migration used Three.js GLTFExporter. CubeRoot maintains scene metadata, texture deduplication and web loading scripts without copying the Blender add-on source. Puzzles, weather, water and traffic still run in Three.js. Accessed 2026-09-08

name: FFmpeg
zh: 网盘云端视频转码与媒体校验，使用独立部署的 FFmpeg 和 ffprobe
en: Cloud video transcoding and media verification for Drive, using separately deployed FFmpeg and ffprobe

name: SVT-AV1
zh: 网盘压缩副本使用的开源 AV1 编码器
en: Open-source AV1 encoder used for compressed Drive copies

name: Netflix VMAF
zh: 网盘视频压缩后的感知画质检查
en: Perceptual quality checks for compressed Drive videos

name: 汇丰大楼照明设计实拍 / HSBC lighting project photographs
zh: 2019-04-28 发布的 2018 年汇丰大楼照明项目，设计署名 FMS 与十聿照明。已查看夜间实拍及屋顶灯位图，用于区分街边灯杆投光、柱廊阴影和屋顶独立照亮穹顶，并调整石材色彩。本站使用固定数量的 Three.js 投光灯，灯位、强度与尺寸仍为估算，未取得实测配光或现状测绘；照片仅本地对照，未作为运行贴图。查阅于 2026-09-08
en: Published 2019-04-28 about the 2018 HSBC lighting project, credited to FMS and 十聿照明. Reviewed night photographs and roof luminaire diagrams to distinguish street-pole facade lighting, colonnade shadows and separate dome lighting, and to adjust stone colour. Implemented with a bounded Three.js spotlight pool; positions, intensity and dimensions remain estimates without measured photometry or an as-built survey. Photographs are local references, not runtime textures. Accessed 2026-09-08

name: 上海市政府：外滩亮灯 / Shanghai Government: Bund lighting
zh: 夜景参考：2026-08-20 转载解放日报关于外滩 38 栋建筑、约 2000K 日常暖金照明与分层景观的报道。用于照明色彩和层次，不代表取得现场灯位、配光或测绘；不将夏季开灯时间套用到场景的固定春秋分时钟。查阅于 2026-09-08
en: Night reference: the 2026-08-20 Jiefang Daily report on 38 Bund buildings, roughly 2000K everyday warm lighting and layered city illumination. Guides colour and hierarchy, without surveyed luminaire positions or photometry; its summer switch-on schedule is not applied to the scene's fixed-equinox clock. Accessed 2026-09-08

name: 新华社：上海夜景实拍 / Xinhua: Shanghai night photographs
zh: 实拍参考：王翔于 2025-12-31 拍摄的外滩和陆家嘴，用于建筑照明的明暗关系、江岸层次、水面倒影及白色前灯、红色尾灯的街道层次。滨江步道、路灯和长椅沿 OSM 位置近似重建，设施细节未实测。照片包含跨年特别灯光，不将红色活动灯幕作为日常现状；图片仅本地审图，未用作运行贴图。模型与灯光仍含估算。查阅于 2026-09-08
en: Photo reference: Wang Xiang's 2025-12-31 Bund and Lujiazui photographs, used for lighting contrast, riverbank layers, water reflections and white headlights/red taillights at street level. Promenade paving, lamps and benches follow OSM alignment with estimated fixture details. They show special New Year lighting; red event displays are not treated as everyday conditions. Photos were reviewed locally, not distributed as runtime textures. Geometry and lighting remain estimates. Accessed 2026-09-08

name: 文汇报：外滩 15-1 号 / Wenhui: Bund 15-1
zh: 实拍对照：外滩公共服务中心的五层立面、中央通高玻璃入口及简洁竖向构件。采用 2019 年报道组合图最下方建成照片，不采用上方未建方案；OSM 平面，垂直尺寸估算，未获现状测绘。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Photo reference: the five-storey Bund Public Service Center, tall central glazed entrance and restrained vertical members. Uses the bottom completed-building photo in the 2019 report, not the unbuilt proposals above; OSM plan and estimated vertical dimensions, without a current survey. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory
zh: 魔方空间太阳方向的时角与天顶角公式参考；场景采用固定春秋分的太阳时近似，查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Hour-angle and zenith equations for Cube Space sun direction, using a fixed equinox and local solar time approximation; accessed 2026-09-07

name: Three.js
zh: 魔方空间的 3D 渲染、物理材质、视角控制、镜面反射、江水及后期处理；外滩立体招牌复用官方 TTFLoader、FontLoader 和 ExtrudeGeometry，使用本地字体子集
en: 3D rendering, physical materials, camera controls, reflections, river water and postprocessing in Cube Space; raised Bund signs reuse official TTFLoader, FontLoader and ExtrudeGeometry with a local font subset
long_en: Three.js is licensed under the MIT license. Cube Space reuses its renderer, controls, Water shader, Reflector and postprocessing modules. The water normal texture from r183 is bundled locally.

name: 和平饭店入口与灯牌实拍 / Peace Hotel entrance and blade sign
zh: 新浪图床的 2022 年文章配图，用于和平饭店南侧双面弧顶竖灯牌、中英文并列竖排、入口与临江立面较亮而侧翼较暗的夜间层次。原文章现不可用，实际拍摄日期未确认；比例、字形和灯光为估算，未作为运行贴图。查阅于 2026-09-08
en: Sina-hosted photo from a 2022 article: curved double-faced blade, adjacent vertical Chinese and English lettering, entrance and brighter riverfront versus dimmer wings at night. The article is unavailable and the capture date is unconfirmed. Dimensions, lettering and lighting are estimated, not a runtime texture. Accessed 2026-09-08

name: 携程：原汇丰大楼实拍 / Ctrip: former HSBC Building
zh: 游客实拍用于上海浦东发展银行位于底层入口上方的招牌，避免误放到高处柱廊檐口；尺寸和字体未实测，照片未作为运行贴图。查阅于 2026-09-08
en: Visitor photographs locate the Shanghai Pudong Development Bank sign above the ground-floor entrances, rather than the upper portico cornice. Dimensions and typeface are not surveyed; photos are not runtime textures. Accessed 2026-09-08

name: 文泉驿微米黑 / WenQuanYi Micro Hei
zh: 外滩招牌复用仓库现有字体，经 Three.js TTFLoader 提取 70 个字形，本地托管约 40 KB 轮廓数据。字体内嵌 Apache-2.0 许可和作者信息随子集保留，许可证随资源附带；通用字体不等于实物品牌字体。生成于 2026-09-08
en: Bund signs subset 70 glyphs from the font already in this repository using Three.js TTFLoader, serving about 40 KB of outlines locally. Embedded Apache-2.0 and author notices are preserved and the license accompanies the asset. This general typeface is not an exact brand font. Generated 2026-09-08

name: Permasteelisa: Jin Mao Tower curtain wall
zh: 幕墙承建方记录金茂大厦 420.5 米、88 层，以及铝制翼片、不锈钢构件和退台铝板。已查看其俯拍、塔冠近景及幕墙细部照片，用于 Blender 工程的分段幕墙、横向栏杆、退台构件和分层翼片塔冠。宽度、层高、构件尺寸与照明仍为照片估算，未取得竣工测绘；照片仅作对照，未作为运行贴图。查阅于 2026-09-08
en: The facade contractor documents Jin Mao Tower's 420.5 m height, 88 storeys, aluminum fins, stainless-steel members and aluminum-clad terraces. Aerial, crown and facade-detail photographs guide the Blender model's tiered curtain wall, horizontal rails, setback members and layered crown fins. Widths, floor heights, member dimensions and lighting remain photo estimates without an as-built survey. Photos are references, not runtime textures. Accessed 2026-09-08

name: SOM: Jin Mao Tower
zh: 设计事务所的日景、夜景实拍用于金茂银灰立面、退台与塔冠对照；三座超高层采用本站独立几何，未导入官方模型。照片未作为运行贴图，开间、构件和照明仍有估算。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: The architect's daytime and nighttime photographs reference Jin Mao's silver facade, setbacks and crown. The three supertalls use locally authored geometry, not official models. Photos are not runtime textures; bays, details and lighting remain estimated. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: The Skyscraper Museum: Jin Mao
zh: 博物馆引用 SOM 的 88 层分段规则：底部 16 层，先每段减 2 层，再每段减 1 层。本站据此推导分段序列，宽度、层高和塔冠仍待施工图校准。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: The museum quotes SOM's 88-floor setback rule: start with 16 floors, then reduce sections by two floors and subsequently by one. The model derives its sequence from this rule; widths, floor heights and crown details still lack construction-drawing calibration. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: Jinmao: 2014 prospectus
zh: 业主 2014 年招股资料提供金茂大厦 420.5 米、88 层依据；用于模型总高，不代表其他尺寸已经测绘。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: The owner's 2014 prospectus documents Jin Mao Tower's 420.5 m height and 88 floors. It supplies the overall model height, not a survey of other dimensions. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: Gensler: Shanghai Tower facade design
zh: 设计研究用于上海中心 632 米轮廓、120° 扭转、圆角三角形外皮、收窄与倾斜塔顶。图 4 的 56.86% 上部比例作为建模参考；资料属于设计阶段，不能代替竣工测绘。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Design research references Shanghai Tower's 632 m profile, 120-degree twist, rounded triangular skin, taper and sloping crown. Figure 4's 56.86% upper-profile scale informs the model; this design-stage document is not an as-built survey. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: Gensler: Shanghai Tower project photographs
zh: 2026-09-08 查看建筑师的竣工远景与仰拍照片，用于 Blender 上海中心的浅银蓝幕墙、水平分格、银色螺旋接缝和倾斜冠部。顶部内层与支撑尺寸仍为估算；程序石材微表面为本站制作，照片未用作运行贴图。尚未通过测绘 1:1 或电影级验收。
en: Completed-building distance and upward photographs reviewed 2026-09-08 for the Blender model's pale silver-blue glazing, horizontal grid, silver spiral seam and sloping crown. Inner crown and strut dimensions remain estimates. Procedural stone micro-surfaces are original work; photographs are not runtime textures. Surveyed 1:1 and cinematic quality remain unverified.

name: KPF: Shanghai World Financial Center
zh: 设计事务所项目资料用于环球金融中心方形基部、弧形收分与顶部梯形开口。2026-09-08 再次查看远景实拍和结构立面图，补 Blender 实体幕墙分格与开口内衬，减弱蓝色轮廓光；新增构件避开贯通开口。幕墙节距、层高与开口尺寸仍为估算，结构图不视为实拍照片。
en: The architect's project references SWFC's square base, curved taper and trapezoidal portal. Distance photographs and a structural elevation were reviewed again 2026-09-08 for physical Blender curtain-wall framing and aperture linings, with restrained blue edge light. New framing leaves the portal open. Mullion pitch, floor levels and aperture dimensions remain estimates; the structural drawing is not a photograph.

name: Shanghai World Financial Center: project facts
zh: 项目官网提供环球金融中心 492 米高度、地上 101 层依据；本站总高按此设定。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: The project website documents SWFC's 492 m height and 101 above-ground floors, used for the model's overall height. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: 上海绿色照明发展报告 2022
zh: 报告第 41–42 页的金外滩与汇丰穹顶夜景，用于暖色洗墙、檐口、绿色铜顶和金色穹顶对照。本站按建筑分层近似照明，未取得现场灯位、配光或色温测量；报告照片不代表当天亮灯状态。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Pages 41–42 show the Golden Bund and HSBC dome, referencing warm facade washes, cornices, green copper and a golden dome. Lighting is approximated per building without measured fixtures, photometry or color temperatures; historical photos do not document today's lighting state. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: 上海市政府：外滩综合改造
zh: 2010-03-23 改造报道提供地面四车道依据；本站沿 OSM 道路线重建外滩路面、标线、铺装和路灯。每侧 7 米宽度、铺装与灯具为估算，未取得现状测绘。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Shanghai's 2010-03-23 Bund renovation report documents four surface lanes. Roads, markings, paving and lamps follow OSM alignment; 7 m carriageways, paving and fixtures are estimates without a current street survey. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: Three.js: Shadows
zh: 官方阴影文档用于外滩近景的阴影覆盖与分辨率调整；汇丰和江海关的窗洞、石材及夜间洗墙为本站实现，尺寸和灯光尚未实测校准。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Official shadow documentation informs shadow coverage and resolution for close Bund views. Recessed windows, stone and night facade wash are local implementations, without surveyed dimensions or measured lighting. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: ABYSSAL / natural-disasters
zh: 魔方空间的大气散射、体积云、雨幕、分叉闪电、体积龙卷风、FFT 海浪与 GPU 飞沫，MIT，已适配住宅、孤岛海岸与镜面
en: Atmospheric scattering, volumetric clouds, rain, branching lightning, volumetric tornadoes, FFT ocean waves and GPU spray in Cube Space, adapted for buildings, island shores and mirrors under MIT
long_en: Copyright (c) 2026 Davi (Token-Gremlin), MIT. Weather and ocean sources are pinned to d2bae38301ff43bc1d43bfdfd9477a552ca5420b. Adaptations include per-scene uniforms, resource disposal, a corrected 3D noise atlas, cloud sampling and spatial resolve, roof shelter, three-cascade FFT waves, projected-grid water shading, foam and ripple baking, airborne GPU spray, and integration with architectural lighting and planar reflections. Island terrain and shoreline attenuation are local additions. Disaster event simulation and demo postprocessing are omitted. Snow, hail, dust, mudslide, rainbow and surface wetness remain local effects.

name: OpenStreetMap contributors
zh: 上海河道、道路、绿地与建筑平面轮廓，ODbL 1.0。建筑由 Three.js 向上拉伸：优先使用记录高度，其次按楼层数 × 3.2 米估算，缺失时默认 12 米。目前多数建筑使用默认高度；地标外形、立面和窗光由本站代码简化生成，并非实景三维扫描。2026-09-08 从既有缓存补入道路单行方向与车道数，车流沿道路及桥面行驶；车辆外形、数量、速度和灯光为本站演示估算，未接入实时交通
en: Shanghai water, roads, parks and building footprints, ODbL 1.0. Three.js extrudes footprints using recorded heights, then floor counts × 3.2 m, or a 12 m fallback. Most buildings currently use the fallback. Landmark shapes, facades and window lights are simplified local models, not a 3D scan. On 2026-09-08, one-way and lane-count tags were added from existing cached extracts. Cars follow roads and bridge elevations; vehicle shapes, counts, speeds and lighting are locally authored visual estimates, not live traffic
long_en: Map data copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, distributed under ODbL 1.0. Local extracts acquired 2026-09-07; bounds, source snapshots, height completeness and texture provenance are recorded in assets/space/shanghai-v1/SOURCE.json. Road metadata was reprocessed on 2026-09-08 without changing geographic coverage. Lane counts are retained as source metadata; traffic uses one central stream per one-way carriageway and two right-hand streams on two-way roads. Missing building heights use an explicit fallback; authored landmark meshes are approximate.

name: 上海市土木工程学会：南浦大桥
zh: 南浦大桥主桥 846 米、主跨 423 米、桥宽 30.35 米、塔高 150 米及拉索、横梁尺寸参考。本站重建几何，引桥高程和构件细部仍有估算。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Shanghai Society of Civil Engineering: Nanpu's 846 m main bridge, 423 m main span, 30.35 m width, 150 m towers, stays and crossbeams. Locally reconstructed geometry; approach elevations and some details remain estimated. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: 上海市土木工程学会：卢浦大桥
zh: 卢浦大桥 100＋550＋100 米跨径、40 米桥宽、100 米拱矢高和 1:5 内倾比例参考。本站重建双拱与吊杆，拱线、杆件截面及高程未按施工图校准。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Shanghai Society of Civil Engineering: Lupu's 100 + 550 + 100 m spans, 40 m width, 100 m arch rise and 1:5 inward inclination. Locally reconstructed arches and hangers; profiles, member sections and elevations are not calibrated to construction drawings. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: 上海市档案馆：外白渡桥
zh: 外白渡桥 107 米长度、18 米宽度、11 米车行道及不等高桁架形式参考。桁架高度、节点板和铆钉仍为形态重建，未取得完整工程模型。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Shanghai Municipal Archives: Waibaidu's 107 m length, 18 m width, 11 m carriageway and variable-height trusses. Truss heights, gussets and rivets are approximations; no complete engineering model was obtained. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: Tomson Group：Tomson Riviera
zh: 汤臣一品开发商项目实拍，用于四栋塔楼的石材、阳台、玻璃和冠顶对照。塔楼、五处裙房及泳池保留 OSM 轮廓；逐栋高度、立面和景观细节仍为估算，庭院没有实测图纸。实拍未作为运行贴图。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Developer photographs reference the four towers' stone, balconies, glazing and crowns. Tower, five podium and pool footprints follow OSM; individual heights, facades and landscape details remain estimated, without a surveyed garden plan. Photos are not runtime textures. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: 新华社：上海海关钟楼
zh: 2025-10-01 现场报道与实拍，提供江海关 79.2 米总高及钟楼形态参考。模型按 OSM 六处主体/附属轮廓重建，补正面凹窗、铜色窗间板和钟楼百叶；钟径、分层高度及构件尺寸仍为估算，四面指针随场景时间同步。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Xinhua onsite report and photographs, 2025-10-01: Customs House's 79.2 m overall height and clock-tower form. The local model uses six OSM building parts, with recessed front windows, bronze-colored spandrels and tower louvers. Dial diameter, stage heights and details remain estimated; all four clocks follow scene time. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: 乐游上海：外滩汇丰银行大楼
zh: 上海旅游图文，经澎湃号转载于 2022-01-20；实拍用于六柱门廊、拱门铜格、凹窗与三角窗饰、八角塔楼、穹顶和石材层次对照。模型保留 OSM 内院，总高暂取 46.3 米，未获测绘证实，雕像等细部尚缺；夜景为近似照明。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Shanghai tourism text and photographs, republished on The Paper on 2022-01-20, reference the six-column portico, bronze arch grilles, recessed windows and pediments, octagonal drum, dome and stone facade. The OSM courtyard remains open; the model's 46.3 m height is unverified, statues remain missing and night lighting is approximate. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: 上海市政府：和平饭店建筑沿革
zh: 和平饭店 77 米总高、19 米铜皮金字塔屋顶及花岗岩外墙参考；模型保留 OSM 三处内院，窗格、退台和楼层分配仍有估算。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Shanghai municipal architectural history: Peace Hotel's 77 m overall height, 19 m copper pyramid roof and granite facade. The model preserves three OSM courtyards; windows, setbacks and floor distribution remain approximate. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: 上海市民政局：外滩建筑群
zh: 外滩建筑名称、门牌、年代与建筑风格的研究清单，用于后续逐栋核对；不代表文中建筑已全部精细复刻。查阅于 2026-09-07
en: Shanghai Civil Affairs Bureau: a research inventory of Bund building names, addresses, dates and styles for individual reconstruction. Inclusion here does not mean every listed building has been rebuilt in detail. Accessed 2026-09-07

name: Asisbiz: 外滩 12 汇丰大楼 / HSBC Building
zh: 实拍用于六柱门廊、柱头叶饰、窗下线脚、入口银行招牌，以及两级八角鼓座、上层平头窗、石栏和穹顶轮廓。石材图为原创程序纹理，非照片扫描；尺寸、雕饰及全圈灯具布置含估算，穹顶雕像和完整立面未达到 1:1。拍摄日期未知，不能据档案照片判断当前招牌与灯光。实拍复核于 2026-09-10
en: Photographs guide the six-column portico, capital leaves, window mouldings, bank sign, two octagonal drum levels, flat-headed upper windows, balustrades and dome silhouette. Masonry maps are original procedural textures, not scans. Dimensions, ornament and fixtures around the dome remain estimates; statues and the complete facade are not verified 1:1. Capture date unknown; archive photos do not establish current signage or lighting. Reviewed 2026-09-10

name: ScareCriterion12：汇丰大楼正立面 / HSBC frontal photograph
zh: ScareCriterion12 于 2021-06-20 拍摄，CC BY-SA 4.0。用于纠正六柱门廊的两组内侧成对柱列，柱间距依次为宽、窄、宽、窄、宽；取代此前误判的等距排列。照片未做正射校正，模型米制间距仍为估算；仅作几何对照，未作为运行贴图。查阅于 2026-09-10

name: Herbert Kociemba — Two-Phase Algorithm & Cube Explorer
zh: Kociemba 两阶段算法 + 立方坐标模型(corner/edge 排列 / twist / flip 编码、面转表):/scramble/solver 的 3×3 两阶段解(含 crz3a 疯狂 3×3)、STM 最优解器的状态编码、cube48opt 服务端最优解器都基于此;Cube Explorer 是已知唯一的 STM 最优解器(参照);/scramble/pattern/search 的图案搜索移植自 Cube Explorer 的 Pattern Editor(PatternSearch.pas);/scramble/symmetry 的对称型搜索与 33 种类型数据移植自 Symmetry Editor(SymSearch.pas + Symmetries.pas + CubeDefs.pas)
en: Kociemba's two-phase algorithm + cube coordinate model (corner/edge perm, twist, flip encoders; face-move tables) underpin the /scramble/solver 3×3 two-phase solve (incl. the crz3a Crazy-3×3 solver), the STM optimal solver's state encoding, and the server-side cube48opt optimal solver; Cube Explorer is the only known prior STM-optimal solver (reference); /scramble/pattern/search ports Cube Explorer's Pattern Editor (PatternSearch.pas), and /scramble/symmetry ports its Symmetry Editor (SymSearch.pas + Symmetries.pas + CubeDefs.pas)
long_en: Herbert Kociemba's two-phase algorithm and the Singmaster cubie coordinate model (corner/edge permutation ranks, corner-twist / edge-flip ranks, face-move arrays — also as ported in cs0x7f's min2phase.js) are the basis of the site's client-side 3×3 two-phase solver (the derive-scramble flow + the crz3a solver), the new pure-TS 3×3×3 STM optimal solver's state encoding (cross-validated against these tables), and the server-side cube48opt optimal-solve daemon. Cube Explorer (kociemba.org) is the only known pre-existing STM-optimal solver — the reference our STM goal-test (centers must end home) follows. The /scramble/pattern/search page is a faithful port of Cube Explorer's Pattern Editor (PatternSearch.pas: abstract face-pattern DFS with color-class bijection matching, continuity check, and isomorphism dedup). The /scramble/symmetry page ports the Symmetry Editor: the 48 symmetry cubie tables of Symmetries.pas, the 33 subgroup bitmasks and per-type position counts of CubeDefs.pas / SymSearch.pas, and the symmetry-constrained DFS of SymSearch.pas (equivariant piece placement, antisymmetry, per-face colour counts, permutation parity modes, exact-symmetry filtering)

en: Korf's IDA* with pattern databases (AAAI 1997) + the sliding-tile walking-distance heuristic: the STM optimal solver's corner PDB (8!×3⁷) + two 6-edge PDBs (12P6×2⁶) with h = max(...), the 15-puzzle (15p) walking-distance optimal solve, and cube48opt's 3×3 optimal solve all use this method
long_en: Richard E. Korf's 'Finding Optimal Solutions to Rubik's Cube Using Pattern Databases' (AAAI 1997) — max/additive pattern-database IDA* — is the method behind the pure-TS 3×3×3 STM optimal solver (corner PDB 8!×3⁷ + two disjoint 6-edge PDBs 12P6×2⁶, admissible h = max of EXACT BFS distances rebuilt over the 27 STM generators) and, via his walking-distance heuristic, the 15-puzzle optimal solver (/scramble/solver 15p); the server-side cube48opt 3×3 optimal-solve daemon is in the same lineage

name: thewca/tnoodle-lib
zh: WCA 官方打乱程序库:二阶 TwoByTwoCubePuzzle / TwoByTwoSolver 的均匀随机状态、恰好 11 步求解与 computeCost 握位代价已移植为共享 WCA 二阶打乱生成器;魔表的 18 位状态模型与转动表(ClockPuzzle.java)移植为 clock_svg.ts,也是本站魔表求解器 @cuberoot/puzzle-solvers/clock 的转动语义锚点;打乱图渲染与各项目配色方案亦照其实现
en: The WCA's official scrambling library: TwoByTwoCubePuzzle / TwoByTwoSolver's uniform random states, exact 11-move search, and computeCost grip model are ported as the shared WCA 2×2 generator; the Clock's 18-dial state model and move table (ClockPuzzle.java) are ported as clock_svg.ts and anchor our Clock solver's move semantics; the scramble-image renderer and per-event colour schemes follow TNoodle too
long_en: TNoodle is the World Cube Association's official scramble generator. CubeRoot's runtime-neutral WCA 2×2 generator faithfully ports `TwoByTwoCubePuzzle` / `TwoByTwoSolver`: it samples a uniform normalized state, enumerates exact 11-move URF solutions, and selects the lowest-cost sequence under TNoodle's `computeCost` grip model. Its `ClockPuzzle.java` (18-dial posit model, the 18 pin-subset move rows, the y2 presentation flip, and the default per-part colour scheme) is also ported to `clock_svg.ts`, which serves as the independent gold standard for cell-by-cell cross-validation of the pure-TS optimal Clock solver

name: Rubik's Clock 最优求解先行工作(Kogler / Rokicki / OptClock / cs0x7f)
zh: 魔表 God's number = 12 的证明与全空间分析:Jakob Kogler 2014 首证,Tomas Rokicki 用陪集求解器算出完整距离分布并公布 39,248 个距离 12 的位置(dist12.txt,本站用作求解器的精确对账集);Michael Gottlieb + Ben Whitmore 的 OptClock 与 Shuang Chen 的 ClockSolver.java 是两份独立的单状态最优求解器。四份代码原样收藏在 solver/reference/clock/(只读、不编译);本站 @cuberoot/puzzle-solvers/clock 为独立实现,未取用其代码
en: The proof that God's number for Clock is 12 and the full-space analysis: first proven by Jakob Kogler (2014); Tomas Rokicki computed the complete distance distribution with a coset solver and published all 39,248 distance-12 positions (dist12.txt — used here as an exact regression oracle); OptClock (Michael Gottlieb + Ben Whitmore) and ClockSolver.java (Shuang Chen) are two independent single-position optimal solvers. All four are archived verbatim under solver/reference/clock/ (read-only, never compiled); our @cuberoot/puzzle-solvers/clock implementation is independent and uses none of their code
long_en: Prior art for optimally solving the Rubik's Clock. Jakob Kogler (2014) first proved God's number is 12 using a one-side lookup table plus iterative-deepening DFS. Tomas Rokicki then computed the complete distance distribution over all 1,283,918,464,548,864 states with a coset solver (subgroup fixing the front cross, 248,832 cosets reduced to 9,906 by mirror / rotation / coprime-multiplication symmetry, ~3 days on a couple of desktops) and published both his source (clockcoset11.cpp) and the 39,248 distance-12 positions (dist12.txt). OptClock by Michael Gottlieb (qqwref) with a Qt GUI by Ben Whitmore is the two-phase single-position optimal solver used to verify those positions. Shuang Chen's ClockSolver.java (GPLv3) is an independent Java optimal solver. All are archived read-only under solver/reference/clock/ with a README explaining each algorithm; dist12.txt is wired into our test suite so the hardest depth bucket is verified exactly rather than by sampling
